newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end weak on sickly bullion price S.African stoc.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end weak on sickly bullion price S.African stoc.

text.p: South African gold shares were battered on Monday by a sickly gold price which also dampened sentiment in industrial shares.
Dealers said some unit trust players tried to lift the market off worst day levels after pushing the market higher at open, but it was too late to have any significant impact.

"It has been erratic this last half-hour. Players were pushing and pulling prices. The market has been all over. The low gold price, which is below the key $380 (an ounce) level also triggered selling in industrials," one said.
The poor August trade surplus figure of 132 million rand also dampened sentiment in industrials and did not bode well for the unit trust close-out, dealers said.
The overall index fell 55.2 points to 6,878 points, the industrial index shed 48.6 points to 8,130.6 points and the gold index dropped 43.3 points, or 2.55 percent, to 1,653.7 points.
